description: A Scala class ErrorClassesJsonReader that loads and processes error class information from JSON files, including methods for retrieving error messages, templates, and validation, along with related data classes and utility objects.

classes.name: ErrorClassesJsonReader
classes.description: A class for reading and querying error class information from JSON files, including error message formatting and validation.

classes.name: ErrorInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about an error class, including message, sub-classes, SQL state, and breaking change info.

classes.name: ErrorSubInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about an error sub-class, including message and breaking change info.

classes.name: BreakingChangeInfo
classes.description: Class containing metadata about a breaking change, including migration message, mitigation config, and audit flag.

classes.name: MitigationConfig
classes.description: Class representing a Spark configuration key-value pair used to mitigate breaking changes.

classes.name: ErrorStateInfo
classes.description: Data class describing an error state/SQLSTATE, including description, origin, standard, and usage.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a formatted error message for a given error class and parameters.

methods.name: getMessageTemplate
methods.description: Fetches the message template string for a specific error class.

methods.name: isValidErrorClass
methods.description: Checks if a given error class string is valid and known.

methods.name: getBreakingChangeInfo
methods.description: Returns optional breaking change information for a specific error class.

methods.name: getMessageParameters
methods.description: Extracts message parameter placeholders from an error message template.

methods.name: readAsMap
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from a URL and converts it into a map of error class to ErrorInfo.
